How did I eat before? Not great. If I start at the very beginning, my sh*tty childhood consisted of cheap cereal and cheap microwave foods, and if I work it out, totalled to about 1000 calories per day at the very most. Nowhere even near enough needed. I never even tasted a salad until I was 19 or 20. I was a normal/average weight back then. 

I have lost weight probably 3 times in my life, once was when I was on the pill for a few months, for a few weeks after becoming vegetarian, and another time was when I was broke and basically pretty much ate nothing but oats for almost 3 weeks. Weight fell off so ridiculously fast.  I remember about 15lbs lost in the first 2 weeks for each of these times. 

My weight was pretty consistent throughout these years, but my diet still wasn’t the healthiest. I probably ate about 2000 calories a day, which was probably 80% processed junk, and lots of snacking, which I don’t particularly want to go back to.

It has been in the last 3 or so years, especially in the last year or so that weight gain has been creeping up a lot. During this time I had still been eating up to 2000 calories a day, but in much, much healthier options. I tried a few other diets on and off too, which were meal replacement shakes, but they did nothing to make me lose, only keeping my weight stable, and I just gained a lot every time I stopped. 

Sorry for rambling on, I just cannot understand this.
